program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    # The marked rectangle is a missing patch in a grid mirrored across its center.
    # Use the opposite side that is not itself covered by the marker.
    if all(grid[r][w - 1 - c] != 3 for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)):
        return [[grid[r][w - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    return [[grid[h - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
'''
prog.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program,str(prog),'exec'),globals())
print(prog, 'saved')
